scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:manual: node tests/manual/browser.cjs source && node tests/manual/browser.cjs dist && node tests/manual/browser.cjs offline && node tests/manual/edge.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run export && npm test && npm run test:manual && npm audit --fetch-retries=0 --fetch-timeout=15000
scripts.verify:offline: npm run check && npm run build && npm run export && npm test && npm run test:manual && npm audit --offline
